Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
This came up in our pub game last night which had 13 players present.
Garry was bleeding John Keech, and John blocked a stealthy action [taken
by Stanislawa] using a vampire who had Raven Spy on him.

Stanislava [DS]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Gangrel
Capacity: 11
Discipline: ANI FOR PRO CEL DOM
Inner Circle: (4 votes) Retainers employed by a minion opposing
Stanislava lose their abilities until the end of combat; allies cannot
block
Stanislava. +2 bleed.

Does this mean that retainers cannot give intercept against actions taken
by Stanislawa? Or just that retainers cannot help their owners when their
owners are in combat against Stanislawa?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter. A minion is not "opposing" unless it is in combat.

"Stanislava" isn't spelled with a 'w', BTW.

--

But during the combat, the Raven Spy doesn't give the + 1 intercept, right? So

can't play Form Of Mist (sup) since 1 > 0.
